title: Hyperbolic marked positive-energy rigidity of k-surfaces for negatively curved metrics pinched above minus one on closed hyperbolic three-manifolds
source_title: Rigidity of the hyperbolic marked energy spectrum and entropy for $k$-surfaces
author: Sébastien Alvarez; Ben Lowe; Graham Andrew Smith
difficulty_reason: Equality of marked energies does not directly yield pointwise curvature rigidity from the prior equidistribution theorem. The authors first prove a uniform near-umbilicity estimate by normalizing nearly round quasicircles and excluding degeneration to a single ideal point, then derive vanishing of the normalized curvature defect along the selected surface sequence. That new geometric compactness/defect argument turns marked-data equality into a full-support rigidity conclusion, beyond merely applying the cited Plateau and equidistribution results.

historical_source_pdf_evidence.original_difficulty_reason: The authors prove uniform near-umbilicity of almost-Fuchsian k-disks, use marked energy equality to force vanishing curvature defect on equidistributed surfaces and obtain ambient hyperbolicity from full-support laminar limits. This surface-energy rigidity exceeds qualifying-exam differential geometry.
